contexts.text: The intellectual things of Spirits and Angels inflow into the left side of the head or brain... In like manner as to the face. AC 644.
Under Influx, see this reference.
Evil Spirits are at the Lord's left.
They apply themselves to the left side beneath the elbow; and also to the left earlap.
One (of the Spirits of the moon) came to me to the left side beneath the arm.
The heat (of those who had been still more delighted with the Word) went from the loins towards the breast; and thence through the left arm to the hand.
The Angelic Spirits... introduced... blackish and shining rays, which darted into the left eye...
(Punishment) beneath the heel of the left foot.
The Spirits who chided, were perceived at the left side beneath the arm.
The other (sound) inflowed towards the left temple...
(These idolaters of the Ancient Church) were in front towards the left...
The left eye = the Intellectual.
(Adulterers seen) before the left eye.
The left side of the brain corresponds to rational or intellectual things.

(These Spirits) presented a flaming lumen... which first appeared beneath the left side of the chin; afterwards beneath the left eye... Afterwards, when I applied my hand to the left side of my... head, I felt a pulsation...
A little star seemed near the region of the left eye... Afterwards, there appeared walls... but only at the left side... It was a representation of the infundibulum...
The involuntary sense... afterwards drew itself towards the left side of the face... SE 3861. SE 3863. Explained.
The left (side of the face, with the left eye, corresponds to) the affection of truth.
The sight of the left eye corresponds to truths, which are of the understanding... consequently, the left eye corresponds to the truths of faith...
For those who are in truth are at the Lord's left.
A Spirit who spoke to me at my left earlap... AC 4657.
They see and interpret all things sinisterly.
Something sonorous was apperceived penetrating from beneath, near the left side, even to the left ear... They were logicians and metaphysicians...
The he-goats on the left = separation according to... falsities from evil... In the other life... those who are in falsities from evil (actually appear) at the left. AC 4882:3.
Some who had imbued [the idea] that man ought not to care for... spiritual things, but only for... natural things... acted into the left knee... and also into the sole of the right foot.
Beneath the left foot, a little to the left, are such as have attributed all things to nature; but still have confessed [a Divine]. Being.
The reason those on the left are called cursed... is that they had averted themselves from good and truth, and had turned to evil and falsity.

The chief place of (this painful suction) was on the top of the head, and it thence propagated itself towards the region of the left ear, and also towards the region of the left eye; that which was from the eye was from Spirits; that which was towards the ear was from Genii; (both of whom) pertain to the province of the cistern and ducts of the chyle...

Those who relate to the kidneys, are at the left side, very closely at the body beneath the elbow. Those who relate to the ureters are towards the left, further away from the body. Those who relate to the bladder are still further away... This is one general way towards the Hells.
Those who have been tenacious of revenge, appeared in front towards the left.
The chaste virgins (of the subsidiary kidneys) ... lie quiet at the left part of the side lower down.
Those who are in the province of the colon extend themselves in front, towards the left, in a curved line, advancing towards Hell.
There appeared to me a wall as of plaster with moulded figures, near the left elbow (which represented the better Spirits of the colon and rectum).
A certain one applied himself to my left side. (His character fully described.) SE 3485.
(One who had been a great adulterer) inflicted pain on the periostea, as on the toes of the sole of the left foot...
When (that hypocrite) was lifted upwards at the left, a pain invaded the left jaw, and the bone of the left temple, down to the bones of the cheek.
Under Inundate, see this reference.
Those who had been bound with me... as they were separated, appeared to be removed from me towards the left in front.
Ephraim... towards Israel's left hand () = the truth of the Intellectual as in the second place... The left hand = to be in the second place.
He placed his left hand upon the head of Manasseh () = that he accounted good in the second place.
The Hell (of profaners) is at the front side to the left, at a great distance.
A multitude of Spirits... at the back, a little to the left, in the plane of the occiput.

The planet Venus appears to the left, a little behind; the planet Mars, to the left, in front; the planet Jupiter, in like manner to the left, in front, but at a greater distance... the moon to the left, at a considerable height; the satellites also to the left, relatively to their own planets. Such is the situation of these planets in the ideas of Spirits and Angels... AC 7247. AC 7358. AC 7800.
Spirits (from Mars) applied themselves to my left temple... It breathed first on the left temple, and on the left ear above; and the afflatus advanced thence to the left eye...
Wrongly explained. AC 7803:2.
By wrong applications. AC 8885:2.
The Spirits who chastise, apply themselves to the left side... AC 7810.
By wrong interpretations. AC 9298:2.
The left eye corresponds to the truth of faith.

By the Lord's left hand is signified the good of spiritual love, which is the good of love towards the neighbour. Hence all things which are on man's... left side correspond to spiritual good. Illustrated.
By the things on the left side (of the body) are signified the truths which are from goods. (Continued. See Right.) AC 9604:end. AC 9736:2. AC 9843:end. AC 10061. HH 118:end. DLW 127.
The Moon (there) appears at a middle altitude opposite the left eye. HH 118.
In the opposite sense... the left, in the Word, = the falsity through which is evil.
At the left (in Heaven) are those who are in the shade of truth, thus who are in the north.
That the left = the truth through which is good. Reference.
The good Spirits were then separated from the evil... the evil to the left...
To the left there, is the north; and this in every turning of their faces and bodies. HH 151:2. AE 298.
The infants who are of a spiritual genius (appear in Heaven) at the left...
The way which tended to the left was narrow, leading through the west to the south... The good were bent to the left, and entered the narrow way which led to Heaven.
Some had a millstone around the left arm. Explained.
The reason there was light when a window was made on the left side... was that light inflowing from Heaven on the left side affects the understanding.
Truth... on the left is what is in obscurity... for the north in Heaven, by which is signified truth in obscurity, is on the left.
The bridegroom sat down on the left.
The door (of the temple) was behind the pulpit on the left.
On the left side of the head... are those who... have despised and injured those things which are good, or which pertain to the affections.
The more direful they are, the more they appear towards the left.
Those among them who begin to have wrong thoughts, dissociate themselves...
When I held my left hand to the left side of the skull or head, I felt a pulsation...
Such is the flux of endeavours and of forces to their centres, everywhere; namely, by spirals from left to right...
That in the left foot up to the knee, dwell those who, being natural, correspond to the celestials.
(To be seen) on the left would be a sign of uses which are not good.

(They said) that (the evil Spirits) are allowed to operate into the right side of the head; but not into the left; and from the right side of the head into the left side of the chest; but by no means into the left side of the head; for so I should be destroyed. SE 3363, Explained. SE 3375. Explained.
A Spirit applied himself to my left side...
Cold was perceived near the left side of the head. Explained.
Those who had been in such principles were elevated through the province of the left foot. SE 3551.
Such strike a pain into the left side of my head... When I did not admit such objections, I felt a pain in the nerves of the left of the neck...
They preside over the left nipple of the breast.
When they are in the persuasion that they are gods (they feel) a delight especially near the left breast...
At this day (the Quakers) only feel a commotion at the left side of the belly, and in the left of the arm just above the palms; and at the same time they keep the left side of the face cheerful.

The rest (of the Quaker Spirits) who were in the deep, by their aspiration affected the region of the left ear, and also the left side of the head... so that they infused some pain into the left side of [my] head; which signifies their insane scientifics.
I spoke... with those who were at the left ear...
(Aristotle's deity seen to the left, above.)
One who held herself... within the transverse suture at the left side of the head.
The point of a spear is then vibrated at their left eye...
I have felt the tumultuation of the Antediluvians beneath the heel of the left foot.
(The action of the solifidians into the left of the body.)
(The solifidians) are above, around the left side of the brain... SE 4880.
(The solifidians) are those who hurt the left knee.
Spirits (who) affect with pain the top of the left side of the tongue.

They operate into that part of the tongue from which there is a communication from the left ear, upwards into the left side of the head... and also to the left eye; and downwards into the left side of the breast, down to some of the toes of the sole of the left foot. (Their character described.)
At the left side in front are very filthy Hells. Described. SE 4642.
(Wolff) was in the plane of the sole of the left foot.
On the left (in the churches there) are those who are in the truths of faith.
At the left (in the cities there) are those who are in falsity from evil.
I was conveyed by the Lord to the left (to a mountain where is the Conjugial).
There was still with them what is hypocritical, because they affected the left side of my head with a dull pain.
Spirits not evil who ascend within the left side, towards the internal ear...
(The hypocrites of what is honest) appeared on the left side at some height...
A Hell on the left in front...
By the left eye is signified the understanding of truth. References. AE 313:end. AC 4734.
The left hand = truth from good.
By the left are signified all things of truth from good.

At an Angel's left is the north; from (which) it is that... the left = truth in shade; or, what is the same... the left = spiritual truth, which is truth in shade; thus also... the left = truth from good. Such things are signified by all... the left parts of the body and also of the head... Illustrated. AE 768:7. AE 984:2. AE 1120:2.
Let not thy left hand know... ()... By the left hand is here meant to know and act without good. Explained.
By the left is signified truth; and, in the opposite sense, falsity.
The prophet Ezekiel was commanded to lie upon his left side (). For... by the left side is signified the doctrine of truth from good; and man is purified from iniquities by means of truths from good.
From left to right, which is contrary to order.
(The Jews) now dwell there at the left.
In the suburbs (of London) at the left, dwell many of their learned, and Newton with them. They descend thither by a declivity.
4. The left side (of this primitive brain) is the receptacle of wisdom.
